title: Document Title Updater
description: Build a component that uses useEffect to update the browser's document title based on a counter value.
requirements: Create a counter state initialized to 0
Add a button with text 'Increment' that increases the counter
Use useEffect to update document.title to show 'Count: X' where X is the current count
The title should update whenever the count changes
hints: Import both useState and useEffect from React
document.title is how you set the browser tab title
useEffect takes a function and a dependency array
Include count in the dependency array so the effect runs when count changes
